payload.claim: The comment "`UnreadablePath` is an unreadable mode or an escaping symlink" describes only two of the three ways `file_at` raises `UnreadablePath`, and mislabels the `src/hop.py` case on line 950: `hop.py` is a symlink to `out.py`, which is itself a symlink (not a regular file), so it raises mirror.py's "symlink target … is not a regular file" branch, not the "escaping symlink" branch (which only `src/out.py` on line 949 triggers). The comment conflates two distinct raise reasons under one label.
